sources.caution: Heuristics and movement costs must match your actual graph.

sources.title: Gaffer on Games: Fix Your Timestep
sources.learn: Understand fixed updates, interpolation and the spiral of death.
sources.caution: A fixed timestep is a stability/consistency technique, not automatically a speed improvement.

sources.title: Gaffer on Games: State Synchronization
sources.learn: Study prioritization, state synchronization and network budgeting.
sources.caution: This is architecture guidance, not a secure networking implementation.

sources.caution: Pools retain memory and require correct reset/ownership rules.

sources.title: Unity: Profiler
sources.learn: Find frame, CPU, GPU and memory information in Unity tooling.
sources.caution: Use documentation matching your Unity version and rendering pipeline.

sources.title: Unity: Garbage collection best practices
sources.learn: Spot allocations that can cause frame-time spikes.
sources.caution: Editor, Mono and IL2CPP behavior can differ; measure the target player.

sources.title: Epic: Unreal Insights
sources.learn: Use traces to reason about tasks, timings and resource usage.
sources.caution: Trace configuration and engine version affect available events.

sources.title: NVIDIA: Nsight Graphics
sources.learn: Inspect GPU captures and hardware performance bottlenecks.
sources.caution: Check supported GPUs/APIs; vendor-specific results do not generalize automatically.

sources.title: RenderDoc
sources.learn: Capture a rendered frame and inspect draws, resources and state.
sources.caution: Frame capture is not a substitute for all timing measurements; platform/API support varies.
sources.page_title: GitHub - baldurk/renderdoc: RenderDoc is a stand-alone graphics debugging tool. · GitHub

sources.title: Tracy profiler
sources.learn: Instrument CPU timelines, allocations and supported GPU workloads.
sources.caution: Instrumentation has overhead and requires correct build/runtime integration.

sources.title: The Rust Performance Book
sources.learn: Learn profiling, allocation and representation tradeoffs in Rust.
sources.caution: Inspect current chapters; release builds and representative workloads are essential.
sources.page_title: GitHub - nnethercote/perf-book: The Rust Performance Book · GitHub

sources.title: Go: Diagnostics
sources.learn: Choose Go profiling and tracing tools, including pprof.
sources.caution: Measure scheduling, allocation and GC as well as function time.

sources.title: Python: The Python Profilers
sources.learn: Use cProfile/profile and understand profiling overhead.
sources.caution: Function profiling and timing answer different questions.

sources.title: Node.js: Profiling
sources.learn: Inspect CPU work in V8/Node applications.
sources.caution: Browser JavaScript needs browser tooling; Node results do not represent rendering performance.

sources.title: Chrome DevTools: Performance
sources.learn: Inspect browser main-thread work, rendering and long tasks.
sources.caution: CPU throttling is an approximation, not a replacement for testing actual devices.

sources.title: Lua 5.4 Reference Manual: Garbage collection
sources.learn: Understand Lua memory management and available collector behavior.
sources.caution: Lua 5.4 and LuaJIT are different runtimes; tuning is not interchangeable.

sources.title: Microsoft: dotnet-trace
sources.learn: Collect runtime traces for allocation, GC and application activity.
sources.caution: Engine-embedded .NET runtimes may need engine-specific tools.

sources.title: LuaJIT: Integrated profiler
sources.learn: Profile code when your actual runtime is LuaJIT.
sources.caution: The repository Lua checks use Lua 5.4, not LuaJIT; no LuaJIT speed claim is made.

sources.title: Introduction to Algorithms, fourth edition
sources.learn: Study complexity, graph algorithms, heaps, hashing and amortized analysis.
sources.caution: A publisher/book reference, not a claim of freely available full text.

sources.title: Game Engine Architecture
sources.learn: Study engine subsystems, memory, scheduling and production architecture.
sources.caution: Check the edition; specific hardware/API details age.

sources.title: GPU Gems 3, Chapter 32: Broad-Phase Collision Detection
sources.learn: Study spatial subdivision and broad-phase collision design.
sources.caution: A historical technical chapter; adapt architecture and GPU assumptions to current hardware.

sources.title: Recast and Detour navigation
sources.learn: Inspect navigation-mesh generation, path queries and crowd-related components.
sources.caution: Integration, agent geometry and dynamic world behavior need separate validation.
sources.page_title: GitHub - recastnavigation/recastnavigation: Industry-standard navigation-mesh toolset for games · GitHub

sources.title: RFC 9000: QUIC
sources.learn: Understand transport flow/congestion control and stream behavior.
sources.caution: Choose a maintained implementation; a transport standard is not a game replication design.

sources.title: Agner Fog: Software optimization resources
sources.learn: Study low-level CPU execution and instruction considerations.
sources.caution: Primarily x86-focused; not a universal model for ARM, mobile GPUs or managed runtimes.

sources.title: LZ4 compression library
sources.learn: Evaluate compression/decompression tradeoffs for suitable data.
sources.caution: Measure payload size, CPU cost and latency together; compression is not encryption.
sources.page_title: GitHub - lz4/lz4: Extremely Fast Compression algorithm · GitHub

sources.title: W3C WebGPU specification
sources.learn: Understand the explicit browser GPU API model.
sources.caution: A specification, not a beginner optimization recipe or universal browser-support promise.

sources.title: Gustafson: Reevaluating Amdahl's Law (1988)
sources.learn: Understand why scaling workload size changes the parallel-speedup question.
sources.caution: Scaled-workload reasoning does not prove lower latency for a fixed frame workload.

sources.title: Little: A Proof for the Queuing Formula L = lambda W (1961)
sources.learn: Relate average arrivals, average queued work and average time in a stable system.
sources.caution: An average steady-state relation, not a bound on worst-case latency.
